---
title: "Heatmap_Chloe"
output: html_document
date: "2025-03-15"
---

Load data
```{r}
anova_tests = read.csv("~/Downloads/test_marcelo.csv")
```

Preprocessing
```{r}
column1 = c()
column2 = c()
for(i in 1:nrow(anova_tests)){
  column1 = c(column1, stringr::str_split(anova_tests$Tukey.s.multiple.comparisons.test, "vs")[[i]][1])
  column2 = c(column2, stringr::str_split(anova_tests$Tukey.s.multiple.comparisons.test, "vs")[[i]][2])
}

matrix_df <- anova_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = column1, y = gsub("\\.", "", column2)) %>%
  group_by(x, y) %>%               # Ensure unique (x, y) pairs
  summarise(value = mean(Predicted..LS..mean.diff.), .groups = "drop") %>%  # Aggregate if needed
  pivot_wider(names_from = y, values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("x") 

pval_df <- anova_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = column1, y = column2) %>%
  group_by(x, y) %>%               # Ensure unique (x, y) pairs
  summarise(value = paste(na.omit(unique(Summary)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%  # Aggregate if needed
  pivot_wider(names_from = y, values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("x") 

matrix_df = as.matrix(matrix_df)
pval_df = as.matrix(pval_df)
textMatrix = paste(signif(matrix_df, 2), "\n(", pval_df, ")", sep = "")
idx = which(is.na(pval_df) | pval_df == "ns")
for (i in idx) {
  textMatrix[i] = NA
}
```

Heatmap
```{r}
pdf("Heatmap_Chloe", width = 18, height = 15)
par(mar = c(25, 20, 3, 3))
labeledHeatmap(Matrix = matrix_df,
               xLabels = colnames(matrix_df),
               yLabels = rownames(matrix_df),
               ySymbols = rownames(matrix_df),
               colorLabels = FALSE,
               colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
               textMatrix = textMatrix,
               setStdMargins = FALSE,
               cex.text = 0.5,
               zlim = c(min(matrix_df, na.rm = T),max(matrix_df, na.rm = T)),
               main = paste("Anova results de Cloe"))
dev.off()
```
